verdict.rationale: Global employment through an employer-of-record or owned-entity payroll is a fair question for a PEO and payroll provider like Justworks, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only US-centric PEO enrollment, W-4 withholding, domestic payments, time off and Xero mapping. Nothing documents an employer-of-record service or international payroll; the 'Domestic' menu label in the payments flow only implies other payment types and is not evidence of global employment.
